hooks.command: bash -c 'BRANCH=$(git -C /workspace/pyvar branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then echo "[pyvar-hook] ERROR: Direct write to main blocked. Use feat/* or fix/*."; exit 1; fi'

bash -c 'FILE="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH:-}"; if [[ "$FILE" == */api/routes/*.py ]] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then cd /workspace/pyvar && python -c "from main import create_app; app=create_app(); print(f\"[pyvar-hook] API OK: {len(app.routes)} routes\")" 2>&1 | tail -2; fi'
